title: Analysis of surgical timing and treatment patterns in patients with cleft lip and palate using Korean Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service (HIRA) big data
html: In cleft lip and palate (CLP), the long-term impacts of surgical timing, use of presurgical orthopaedic appliances, and cleft extent on craniofacial growth remain debated. Claims data from the Korean Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service were leveraged to perform a retrospective analysis based on diagnostic and procedure codes. The study included 23,401 patients aged <40 years treated between 2007 and 2023. The surgical timing, cleft type and extent, use of presurgical orthopaedic appliances, and their associations with maxillary growth-related interventions, revision procedures, otitis media, and tympanostomy tube insertion were evaluated.
